blocking.title: R29b's ship sails the one aboard to the new landing's port but never joins the convoy loading there: that convoy sails at once and the division that was there first lands alone and is destroyed (regression from 76b88197)
blocking.evidence: Britain at war with France, seed 15101 (7019 the same), by real clicks on the HEAD page: divisions 270 and 271 clicked onto Calais; 270 boards 1068 at Portsmouth (t63); paused at t64 the fresh tank brigade 276 clicked onto Caen, then 270+271 clicked there. 270's group sails Portsmouth->Plymouth with it aboard and waits for 271 marching; 276's group sails at once: 276 lands alone h87 and is destroyed h237, 270/271 land h291; no order news; 270's panel says '1 of 2 aboard' (critic/c41_mk4_eng15101_p270.json, critic/shots/c41mk4_eng15101_p270_firstland.png, critic/c41_mk4_eng7019_p270.json). On 76b88197 the same clicks land all three h291 (critic/c41_mk4_old_eng15101_p270.json; per-order replica critic/c41_gwtper_eng_15101_pick270_271.json). Headless with ascending ids as player.ts sends: 276 h84 alone, destroyed h233 (critic/c41_g_eng_15101_pick270_271.json). Mechanism trace: critic/c41_g_eng_15101_hourly.json (1068 gets convoyPort Plymouth, 271 stays bound for 1068, nobody bound for 276's 1072, convoySystem sails it).
blocking.fix: A group sailAboard sends to a port where a convoy for the same target loads is part of that convoy: the convoy waits for it (and those still bound for it) as for a division still to come, or the leavers still marching are bound to the port's convoy rather than the ship under way. AT through player.click (ids ascending): Britain 15101, 270/271 + 276 to Caen as above, all three land within a day, 276 never alone; R29b's Japan cases unchanged.
